origin: hand-derived from CSS Cascade §6.6.3 (`!important` outranks normal declarations of the same origin, regardless of specificity) — NOT captured from any engine
note: THIS CASE IS EXPECTED TO DISAGREE. RustKit parses `!important` and carries the flag through to the cascade, but `compute_style_for_element` orders matching rules by specificity and source index only — nothing reads the flag. So the engine computes 400px where every browser computes 100px. The reference states the CORRECT answer, so `hiwave_diff` reports the bug rather than blessing it. When the cascade is fixed, this case starts AGREEING and crates/hiwave-mcp/smoke.py must be updated to expect zero disagreements — that flip is the intended signal, not a test failure to route around.

expect.why: `div { width: 100px !important }` outranks `.hero { width: 400px }` despite lower specificity
no padding and no border declared, so the border box is the content width
height: 120px is declared once and uncontested — this one must AGREE, so a disagreement here would mean the case broke rather than the cascade
body margin 0 — also expected to agree
